title: Works Well, But Far Too Small
text: Works Well, But Far Too Small. This is a decent soap dispenser, I'm happy with the foam and with how easy it is to use.  But it holds so little soap!  I've got 7 people with 2 bathrooms and this doesn't last a day!  So I'm not going to keep using it.

product_metadata.title: Soap Dispenser, Automatic Touchless Foaming Soap Dispenser 8.12 oz, Infrared Sensor, Rechargeable, for Bathroom Kitchen Hotel Restaurant
features: Infrared non-Contact Soap Dispenser, Carrying an outstanding infrared precise motion sensor, Kunphy automatic foaming soap dispenser can quickly foam in 0.25 seconds. Without any contact, you can get dense foam when you reach out.
Easy Refill: Remove the soap tank from the bottom to refill. You don't have to worry about the damage by liquid seeping into the dispenser through the button.
High Precise Sensor Design: With quick sensor design, it could be activated in high speed and dispense foam instantly by a wave.
Easy Operation: Operate it with a single button. Long Press it to turn on/off, light press to choose high/low soap mode
